_note: Hand-written. {m:…|f:…} is resolved by the app from the learner's gender. Characters are original to this pack.

ola.name: Ola
ola.bio: 26, barista at Kawiarnia pod Lipą, a small café in Kazimierz, Kraków
ola.register: neutral with new customers, informal (ty) with regulars

marek.name: Pan Marek
marek.bio: 68, retired tram driver, the learner's neighbour

kasia.name: Kasia
kasia.bio: 22, computer science student, the learner's friend

basia.name: Pani Basia
basia.bio: 55, owns a fruit and vegetable stall at Stary Kleparz market and rents out a small flat

zbyszek.name: Pan Zbyszek
zbyszek.bio: 50, runs a kiosk at a tram stop and drives a taxi at weekends
loves: old Polish rock on the radio

ania.name: Ania
ania.bio: 35, the learner's team lead at work, from Warsaw

scenarios.title: Hello, neighbour
scenarios.scene: the stairwell of your new block of flats; you have just moved in
scenarios.can_do: introduce yourself and say where you are from
mission: Say hello and tell him your name
scenarios.twist: He mishears your name; say it again or spell it.

opener.pl: Dzień dobry! Jestem Marek, mieszkam pod siódemką.
opener.en: Good morning! I'm Marek, I live at number seven.

first.pl: {m:A pan to nowy sąsiad?|f:A pani to nowa sąsiadka?}

closer.en: Very nice to meet you. Goodbye!

phrases: Jestem z Anglii / z Indii / z Chin

grammar.text: być z + genitive for where you're from: z Polski, z Anglii

scenarios.title: Your first coffee
scenarios.scene: Kawiarnia pod Lipą, a small café in Kazimierz; your first visit
scenarios.can_do: order a drink and a snack and pay
mission: Ask how much it is and pay
scenarios.twist: The cheesecake (sernik) has just sold out; choose something else.

opener.en: Hello! What can I get you?

first.pl: Kawa, herbata? Mamy też dzisiaj świeży sernik.
first.en: Coffee, tea? We also have fresh cheesecake today.

closer.en: Enjoy! See you!

phrases: To have here / to take away

grammar.text: poproszę + accusative: kawa → kawę, herbata → herbatę

scenarios.title: A new colleague
scenarios.scene: the office kitchen on your first day at work
scenarios.can_do: say what you do and where you live
scenarios.twist: She thinks you work in another team; correct her.

opener.pl: {m:Cześć! Ty jesteś nowy?|f:Cześć! Ty jesteś nowa?}

first.pl: Jestem Ania, z marketingu. A ty w jakim dziale pracujesz?
first.en: I'm Ania from marketing. Which department do you work in?

closer.pl: Dobra, muszę lecieć na spotkanie. Na razie!
closer.en: OK, I have to run to a meeting. See you!

grammar.text: być + instrumental for jobs (jestem nauczycielem); w + locative for places (w centrum)

scenarios.title: How are you?
scenarios.scene: a video call with your friend Kasia late in the evening
scenarios.can_do: say how you are and what you are doing
mission: Say what you are doing right now
scenarios.twist: Her internet keeps cutting out; ask her to repeat.

first.en: How are you? What are you doing?

closer.en: OK, I'm going to bed. Good night!

phrases: Right now I'm cooking / reading / watching a film

grammar.text: present tense: czytam, czytasz; piszę, piszesz

scenarios.title: Tram tickets
scenarios.scene: Pan Zbyszek's kiosk at a tram stop
scenarios.can_do: buy tickets and understand prices
mission: Ask for tickets: how many and what kind
scenarios.twist: He has no change for a 100-złoty note.

closer.en: Here you are. Have a nice day!

grammar.text: numbers with nouns: jeden bilet, dwa bilety, pięć biletów

scenarios.title: At the market
scenarios.scene: Pani Basia's fruit and vegetable stall at Stary Kleparz market
scenarios.can_do: buy food by weight and pay
scenarios.twist: She tries to sell you strawberries as well; say no politely.

opener.en: Hello, dear! What will it be today?

first.en: I've got beautiful Polish apples. How many?

closer.en: Thank you, dear. Come again!

grammar.text: quantity + genitive plural: kilo jabłek, pół kilo pomidorów

scenarios.title: Swapping numbers
scenarios.scene: after a party; Kasia wants your phone number and email
scenarios.can_do: give and check a phone number and an email address
scenarios.twist: She writes one digit wrong; correct her.

closer.en: Great, got it! I'll text tomorrow. Bye!

grammar.text: numbers 0–100

scenarios.title: Fresh bread
scenarios.scene: Ola's café, which also sells fresh bread in the morning
scenarios.can_do: buy several items and handle a short wait
mission: Ask for bread rolls: say how many
Ask what else is fresh today
scenarios.twist: The rolls are still in the oven: wait five minutes or choose something else.

closer.en: Here you are. Enjoy!

grammar.text: dwie, trzy, cztery bułki but pięć bułek

scenarios.title: Lunch at a milk bar

guest.name: Pani Halina
guest.bio: 60, serves at the counter of a traditional bar mleczny (milk bar)

scenarios.scene: a bar mleczny at lunchtime, with a queue
scenarios.can_do: order a full meal at a counter
scenarios.twist: The pierogi ruskie are sold out; choose something else.

first.pl: Dzisiaj jest pomidorowa i żurek. Co podać?
first.en: Today there's tomato soup and żurek. What can I get you?

closer.en: Here you are, enjoy. Next!

phrases: Pierogi with cheese and potato, please

grammar.text: poproszę + accusative

scenarios.title: Dinner at Tomek's
scenarios.scene: Tomek's flat; he has cooked dinner for you
scenarios.can_do: say what you like and don't like to eat
mission: Say what you like and don't like
Say you are full, or ask for more
scenarios.twist: He offers you mushrooms; you don't eat them.

opener.pl: {m:Cześć! Wchodź! Jesteś głodny?|f:Cześć! Wchodź! Jesteś głodna?}
opener.en: Hi! Come in! Are you hungry?

first.pl: Zrobiłem bigos i sałatkę. Lubisz bigos?
first.en: I made bigos and a salad. Do you like bigos?

closer.pl: Cieszę się, że ci smakowało. Do zobaczenia!
closer.en: I'm glad you liked it. See you!

phrases: Thanks, I can't eat any more

grammar.text: nie + genitive: nie lubię grzybów, nie jem mięsa

scenarios.title: Party shopping
scenarios.scene: a supermarket with Kasia, shopping for a party
scenarios.can_do: say what you need, have and don't have
mission: Say what you need to buy
Say what you already have or don't have
scenarios.twist: Kasia wants to buy only crisps; suggest something healthier.

first.pl: Mamy chleb? Bo ja nie mam nic w lodówce.
first.en: Do we have bread? Because I've got nothing in the fridge.

closer.en: OK, let's pay and go!

grammar.text: potrzebuję + genitive; nie mamy + genitive

scenarios.title: The wrong order
scenarios.scene: Ola's café on a busy afternoon; your order comes out wrong
scenarios.can_do: explain a simple problem politely
mission: Accept her offer or ask for something else
scenarios.twist: She brings tea instead of coffee, and there's no oat milk today.

opener.en: Here you are, tea with lemon!

closer.en: Sorry again! Have a nice day!

phrases: Sorry, but I ordered coffee (m / f)

grammar.text: bez + genitive: bez cukru, bez mleka

scenarios.title: Which way to the station?
scenarios.scene: a street in the centre; you bump into Pan Marek and ask the way to the main station
scenarios.can_do: ask for and understand simple directions
mission: Ask the way to the station
scenarios.twist: He describes a shortcut through the park too fast; ask him to repeat slowly.

opener.pl: {m:O, dzień dobry! Co pan tu robi?|f:O, dzień dobry! Co pani tu robi?}
opener.en: Oh, hello! What are you doing here?

closer.pl: Nie ma za co. Do widzenia!
closer.en: You're welcome. Goodbye!

phrases: How do I get to… (on foot)?

grammar.text: do + genitive: do dworca, do centrum

scenarios.title: A ticket to Warsaw

guest.name: Pani Grażyna
guest.bio: 58, ticket clerk at Kraków Główny station
loves: passengers who know where they're going

scenarios.scene: the ticket office at Kraków Główny station
scenarios.can_do: buy a train ticket and understand times and platforms
mission: Ask for a ticket to Warsaw: one way or return
scenarios.twist: The 10:00 train is full; take a later one.

closer.en: Platform three. Have a good journey!

grammar.text: do + genitive (do Warszawy); o + locative for clock time (o dziesiątej)

scenarios.title: Taxi to the hotel
scenarios.scene: a taxi from the airport; Pan Zbyszek is driving
scenarios.can_do: say where you're going and talk about time and price
scenarios.twist: There's a traffic jam; he asks if a longer route is OK.

opener.en: Good afternoon. Where are we going?

first.en: To the centre? What's the address?

closer.en: Here we are. Enjoy your stay!

grammar.text: jechać do + genitive

scenarios.title: Where are you?
scenarios.scene: Kasia is waiting for you at a café, but you're lost; she calls
scenarios.can_do: say where you are and when you'll arrive
mission: Say where you are and what you can see
scenarios.twist: You realise you took the wrong tram.

first.pl: Co widzisz? Jest tam jakiś sklep albo przystanek?
first.en: What can you see? Is there a shop or a stop?

closer.pl: Dobra, czekam! Do zobaczenia za chwilę.
closer.en: OK, I'm waiting! See you in a bit.

phrases: I can see a church / a park / a shop
I think I'm on the wrong tram
I'll be there in ten minutes

grammar.text: na / w + locative: na przystanku, w tramwaju

scenarios.title: Viewing a flat
scenarios.scene: viewing a small flat that Pani Basia rents out
scenarios.can_do: ask about a flat and say what you think of it
mission: Ask how many rooms there are
Ask about the rent and bills
Say what you like or don't like
scenarios.twist: The washing machine doesn't work; ask when it will be fixed.

opener.pl: Dzień dobry, kochanie! Zapraszam do środka.

first.en: This is the living room. Nice, isn't it?

closer.pl: Proszę się zastanowić i zadzwonić. Do widzenia!
closer.en: Have a think and give me a call. Goodbye!

phrases: How much is it per month?

grammar.text: jest / nie ma + genitive: nie ma windy

scenarios.title: Show me your room
scenarios.scene: a video call; Kasia wants to see your new room
scenarios.can_do: describe a room and say what's missing
mission: Describe three things in your room
scenarios.twist: She says your room looks empty; say what you want to buy.

first.en: Have you got a big bed?

closer.en: Nice room! OK, bye!

phrases: There's a desk and a chair here
I want to buy a lamp
Mój pokój jest mały, ale ładny
My room is small but nice

grammar.text: adjectives agree: duże okno, mały stół, ładna lampa

scenarios.title: A morning run
scenarios.scene: Tomek wants to go running with you and asks about your routine
scenarios.can_do: talk about your daily routine and times
mission: Say what time you get up
Say what you do in the morning
Agree on a time to run
scenarios.twist: He wants to run at six; suggest a later time.

opener.en: Hi! Are we running tomorrow morning?

first.en: What time do you get up?

closer.en: Great, see you tomorrow!

phrases: In the morning I drink coffee
I go to work at nine

grammar.text: o + locative for clock time: o siódmej, o ósmej

scenarios.title: No hot water
scenarios.scene: there's no hot water in your flat, so you knock on Pan Marek's door
scenarios.can_do: explain a problem at home and ask for advice
mission: Ask what to do or who to call
scenarios.twist: He says it's the whole building; you need to call the building management.

closer.en: Call the building management. Good luck!

grammar.text: nie ma + genitive: nie ma wody

scenarios.title: When are you free?
scenarios.scene: planning to go to the cinema with Kasia this week
scenarios.can_do: arrange a day, time and place to meet
scenarios.twist: She's busy on the day you suggest.

opener.pl: Hej! Idziemy w tym tygodniu do kina?
opener.en: Hey! Shall we go to the cinema this week?

closer.en: Great, see you at the cinema!

phrases: Let's meet in front of the cinema

grammar.text: w + accusative for days: w piątek, w sobotę

scenarios.title: Weekend in the mountains?
scenarios.scene: Tomek invites you to the mountains this weekend
scenarios.can_do: talk about weekend plans and accept or decline
mission: Say what you usually do at weekends
scenarios.twist: The forecast says rain; suggest something else.

opener.pl: Cześć! Jedziemy w sobotę w góry?
opener.en: Hi! Shall we go to the mountains on Saturday?

first.en: What do you usually do at weekends?

closer.pl: Dobra, napiszę ci szczegóły. Na razie!
closer.en: OK, I'll text you the details. See you!

grammar.text: jechać w góry / nad morze (direction)

scenarios.title: Booking the doctor

guest.name: Pani Krysia
guest.bio: 50, receptionist at the Zdrowie health clinic

scenarios.scene: a phone call to the clinic to book an appointment
scenarios.can_do: book an appointment by phone
mission: Agree on a day and time
scenarios.twist: The doctor is only free next week; ask if there's anything earlier.

closer.en: You're booked in. Goodbye!

phrases: I'd like to make an appointment

grammar.text: days and times: we wtorek o dziesiątej

scenarios.title: A birthday invitation
scenarios.scene: Ania invites you to her birthday party
scenarios.can_do: accept an invitation and ask for details
scenarios.twist: It clashes with another plan; ask if you can come later.

opener.en: Listen, it's my birthday on Saturday!

closer.en: Great! See you on Saturday!

grammar.text: simple future of przyjść: przyjdę, przyjdziesz

scenarios.title: At the doctor's
scenarios.scene: Doktor Nowak's surgery
scenarios.can_do: describe symptoms and understand advice
mission: Say how long you've had them
Ask a question about the treatment
scenarios.twist: She asks if you're allergic to anything; you're allergic to penicillin.

closer.pl: Proszę brać te tabletki i odpoczywać. Dużo zdrowia!
closer.en: Take these tablets and rest. Get well soon!

phrases: I have a headache / a sore throat

grammar.text: boli mnie + noun; od + genitive for how long

scenarios.title: At the pharmacy
scenarios.scene: a pharmacy; you need something for a cold
scenarios.can_do: ask for medicine and understand how to take it
mission: Ask for something without a prescription
scenarios.twist: What you ask for needs a prescription; she suggests something else.

closer.pl: Proszę dużo pić i odpoczywać. Do widzenia!
closer.en: Drink plenty and rest. Goodbye!

phrases: I have a runny nose and a cough

grammar.text: na + accusative for purpose: coś na przeziębienie, na kaszel

scenarios.title: Calling in sick
scenarios.scene: you call Ania, your team lead, early in the morning
scenarios.can_do: explain you're ill and rearrange work
mission: Say you're ill and can't come in
Agree what happens with today's meeting
scenarios.twist: She asks if you could join the meeting online.

closer.pl: Wracaj do zdrowia! Odezwij się jutro.
closer.en: Get well soon! Get in touch tomorrow.

phrases: I won't come to work today

grammar.text: perfective future for one-off events: przyjdę, wrócę

scenarios.title: At the gym
scenarios.scene: Tomek takes you to his gym for the first time
scenarios.can_do: talk about sport and say what's too hard
mission: Say what sport you do and how often
scenarios.twist: He pushes you to try something too hard; say it hurts.

closer.en: Well done! Until next time!

grammar.text: grać w + accusative (grać w piłkę), grać na + locative (grać na gitarze)

scenarios.title: How was your weekend?
scenarios.scene: Monday morning coffee with Kasia
scenarios.can_do: say what you did and where you were
mission: Say two things you did at the weekend
scenarios.twist: She doesn't believe your story; add one more detail.

closer.en: OK, I'm off to class. Bye!

phrases: I was at the cinema (m / f)
I met up with friends (m / f)
And what did you do? (to Kasia)

grammar.text: past tense with gender: byłem / byłam

scenarios.title: A trip to Gdańsk
scenarios.scene: Pan Marek asks about your trip to Gdańsk
scenarios.can_do: describe a trip and give an opinion
mission: Say how you travelled and how long it took
scenarios.twist: He insists Kraków is more beautiful; disagree politely.

opener.pl: {m:O, dzień dobry! Podobno był pan nad morzem?|f:O, dzień dobry! Podobno była pani nad morzem?}
opener.en: Oh, hello! I hear you were at the seaside?

closer.pl: No, następnym razem proszę mi przywieźć bursztyn! Do widzenia.
closer.en: Well, next time bring me some amber! Goodbye.

phrases: I saw the old town (m / f)

grammar.text: past tense; jechać pociągiem (instrumental for transport)

scenarios.title: You won't believe it!
scenarios.scene: an evening chat; Tomek has a story and wants to hear yours
scenarios.can_do: tell a short story in order
mission: Tell a short story about something that happened to you
scenarios.twist: He interrupts with questions; answer and carry on.

opener.pl: Nie uwierzysz, co mi się dzisiaj stało!
opener.en: You won't believe what happened to me today!

first.pl: A tobie przydarzyło się dzisiaj coś ciekawego?
first.en: And did anything interesting happen to you today?

closer.en: Ha! Good story. Good night!

grammar.text: perfective past for finished events in a story: zgubiłem, znalazłem

scenarios.title: A stolen wallet

guest.name: Sierżant Lis
guest.bio: 40, Piotr Lis, a police officer at the city police station

scenarios.scene: a police station; your wallet was stolen on the tram
scenarios.can_do: report what happened and describe an object
mission: Describe the wallet and what was in it
scenarios.twist: He asks where exactly it happened, and you're not sure.

opener.pl: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
opener.en: Good afternoon. How can I help?

closer.pl: Zgłoszenie przyjęte. Zadzwonimy, jeśli coś znajdziemy.
closer.en: Report taken. We'll call if we find anything.

phrases: Były w nim karty i dowód osobisty
My cards and ID card were in it

grammar.text: past tense of być: był, była, było, były

scenarios.title: Returning a jacket

guest.name: Pani Monika
guest.bio: 28, a shop assistant in a clothes store

scenarios.scene: a clothes shop; the jacket you bought is too small
scenarios.can_do: return or exchange something and explain why
mission: Say you want to return or exchange it
scenarios.twist: You don't have the receipt; you paid by card.

opener.pl: Dzień dobry! W czym mogę pomóc?

closer.en: All done. Thank you and come again!

phrases: I'd like to return this jacket (m / f)
Can I exchange it for a bigger one?

grammar.text: polite conditional: chciałbym / chciałabym

scenarios.title: Sending a parcel

guest.name: Pani Wiesia
guest.bio: 57, a clerk at the post office

scenarios.scene: the post office; you're sending a parcel abroad
scenarios.can_do: send a parcel and choose a service
mission: Answer her questions about the contents
scenarios.twist: The parcel is too big for the box; buy a bigger one.

closer.pl: Proszę, tu jest numer przesyłki. Do widzenia.
closer.en: Here's the tracking number. Goodbye.

phrases: I want to send a parcel to England

grammar.text: comparatives of adverbs: taniej, szybciej

scenarios.title: Opening a bank account

guest.name: Pan Tadeusz
guest.bio: 45, an adviser at a bank branch

scenarios.scene: a bank branch
scenarios.can_do: open an account and ask about costs
mission: Say you want to open an account
Answer his questions about ID and address
Ask about the card and fees
scenarios.twist: You need a Polish phone number; give one or ask what else works.

opener.en: Good morning, come in. Please take a seat.

closer.en: All done. The card will come by post.

phrases: I want to open an account

grammar.text: płacić za + accusative: opłata za konto

scenarios.title: At the hairdresser's

guest.name: Pani Jola
guest.bio: 38, a hairdresser who loves to chat

scenarios.scene: a hair salon
scenarios.can_do: say how you want something done and stop a mistake
mission: Say what you want: a trim, shorter, a colour
scenarios.twist: She starts cutting too much; stop her politely.

closer.en: And done! Do you like it?

grammar.text: adverbs and comparatives: krótko, krócej

scenarios.title: A job interview

guest.name: Pani Dorota
guest.bio: 42, HR manager at a software company in Kraków

scenarios.scene: a short video interview for a job
scenarios.can_do: talk about your experience and ask about a job
mission: Say why you want the job
Ask one question about the job
scenarios.twist: She asks about your weak points.

opener.en: Good morning, nice to meet you. Shall we start?

first.en: Please tell me a little about yourself.

closer.pl: Dziękuję, odezwiemy się w przyszłym tygodniu.
closer.en: Thank you, we'll be in touch next week.

phrases: I've been working as … for five years
I know English and some Polish
I'm interested in this job because…

grammar.text: od + genitive with the present tense: od pięciu lat pracuję

scenarios.title: Signing up for a Polish course
scenarios.scene: a language school office
scenarios.can_do: enrol on a course and ask practical questions
mission: Say your level and your goal
Ask the price and what's included
scenarios.twist: The group you want is full; choose another.

first.pl: {m:Jaki kurs pana interesuje?|f:Jaki kurs panią interesuje?}
first.en: Which course are you interested in?

closer.en: See you at the first class!

phrases: In the evening, twice a week

grammar.text: interesować się + instrumental; interesuje mnie + nominative

scenarios.title: Can you help me?
scenarios.scene: at work; you need Ania's help with a report
scenarios.can_do: ask for help politely and agree a time
scenarios.twist: She's busy until three o'clock.

closer.pl: Dobra, to o piętnastej u mnie. Na razie!
closer.en: OK, at three at my desk. See you!

phrases: I have a problem with the report

grammar.text: polite requests: czy możesz + infinitive

scenarios.title: Moving a meeting
scenarios.scene: you need to move tomorrow's meeting
scenarios.can_do: reschedule with a reason
mission: Say you can't make the meeting and why
scenarios.twist: Everyone else is only free on Friday morning.

opener.pl: Hej, mam chwilę. O co chodzi?
opener.en: Hey, I've got a minute. What's it about?

closer.en: OK, I'm sending a new invite. Bye!

grammar.text: joining ideas: bo, ale, więc

scenarios.title: Checking in

guest.name: Pan Adam
guest.bio: 34, receptionist at a guesthouse in Zakopane

scenarios.scene: the reception of a guesthouse in Zakopane
scenarios.can_do: check in and sort out a problem with a room
mission: Report a problem with the room
scenarios.twist: Your room faces a noisy street; ask for another.

first.en: What name is the reservation under?

closer.en: Enjoy your stay!

phrases: I have a reservation under the name…

grammar.text: na + accusative (na nazwisko); o której? o ósmej

scenarios.title: Planning a trip
scenarios.scene: planning a weekend in the Tatra mountains with Tomek
scenarios.can_do: plan a trip and share tasks
mission: Split the tasks: who buys what
scenarios.twist: The bus is sold out; find another way.

opener.en: Listen, we're going to the Tatras!

first.en: How are we going: by train or by bus?

closer.en: Great, it'll be brilliant! See you Saturday!

phrases: We can sleep in a mountain hostel
And if there are no seats?

grammar.text: instrumental for transport (pociągiem); perfective future (kupię)

scenarios.title: What will the weather be like?
scenarios.scene: you meet Pan Marek on your way out with a big backpack
scenarios.can_do: talk about the weather and future plans
mission: Say where and when you're going
scenarios.twist: He says there'll be a storm; ask if you should still go.

opener.pl: {m:Dzień dobry! Gdzie się pan wybiera z tym plecakiem?|f:Dzień dobry! Gdzie się pani wybiera z tym plecakiem?}
opener.en: Hello! Where are you off to with that backpack?

first.pl: {m:A sprawdzał pan pogodę?|f:A sprawdzała pani pogodę?}
first.en: And have you checked the weather?

closer.pl: Proszę uważać na siebie. Szczęśliwej drogi!
